title: IDOR in Appointment Routes - PATCH /appointments/:id/status
description: The PATCH /api/v1/appointments/:id/status endpoint allows any authenticated user to modify the status of any appointment by providing its ID. The vulnerable implementation calls cancelAppointment.execute (or confirmAppointment/completeAppointment) with only the appointment ID, without verifying that the requesting user owns or is associated with the appointment. A CUSTOMER can cancel or confirm appointments belonging to other customers.
impact: Cross-customer appointment manipulation. A malicious customer can cancel, confirm, or complete appointments belonging to other customers, causing service disruption and data integrity issues.
mitigation: Implement ownership validation in the appointment status update handler. Verify that the requesting user is either the appointment's customer (customerId matches userId), the assigned barber (barberId matches userId), or an ADMIN. Compare with secure implementation in appointment_routes_secure.md which uses checkAppointmentAccess middleware.
